import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/services/uk-low-value-csv-buyer')
source = root / 'raw/tender-feed.json'
raw = source.read_bytes()
releases = json.loads(raw)['releases']
rows = []
for release in releases:
    tender = release.get('tender') or {}
    rows.append({'ocid': release.get('ocid'), 'release_id': release.get('id'), 'tags': release.get('tag'), 'buyer': (release.get('buyer') or {}).get('name'), 'status': tender.get('status'), 'title': tender.get('title'), 'description': tender.get('description'), 'deadline': (tender.get('tenderPeriod') or {}).get('endDate'), 'lots': [{k: lot.get(k) for k in ('id', 'title', 'description', 'status')} for lot in tender.get('lots', [])], 'notice_urls': [doc['url'] for doc in tender.get('documents', []) if isinstance(doc.get('url'), str)]})
output = root / 'director-scope-readback.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps({'source': str(source), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'scope': 'One captured feed page. Source fields for human or agent review. No inferred eligibility or demand.', 'releases': rows}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
check = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(check['releases']) == len(releases)
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'release_count': len(rows), 'titles': [row['title'] for row in rows]}, ensure_ascii=False))
